core.title: Hargrove steel price rise
core.setting: Workshop foreman at Ironline Custom Fabrication, a metalworking shop

events.text: Standing instruction for the shop: any supplier order over 5000 needs sign-off from Priya Nayak, our finance lead, before it is placed. Anything at or under 5000 I can approve myself.
Shop policy on client work: once a client has confirmed a quoted price, we do not change that price without the client's own agreement, whatever happens to our material costs.
Yard notes: the goods-in dock takes one delivery in the morning slot starting 08:00. Priya Nayak handles finance on Tuesdays and Thursdays and wants order totals in whole numbers.
Quote from Casta Fasteners: M8 zinc-plated bolts, boxes of 500, at 38 per box, quote held for 60 days.
Owen Pruitt called to cancel the small gate repair we had pencilled in for late August; he will come back to us in the spring.
Petra Lind at WeldRight Training confirms she can run a one-day welder refresher at our shop on Friday 20 November 2026, at 350 per person, up to six welders.
Luis Ferro at Hargrove Metals writes: 6mm mild steel plate is 980 per tonne, and we can deliver 4 tonnes to the Ironline yard on Tuesday 10 November 2026, morning drop.

Dana Vance of Vance Railings confirms they need the balcony railing job fabricated and ready for collection in the week of Monday 16 November 2026. Dana is the one who signs off anything on their side.

Placed the order with Hargrove Metals: 4 tonnes of 6mm mild steel plate at 980 per tonne, total 3920, delivery to our goods-in dock on Tuesday 10 November 2026. At 3920 it is under the 5000 line, so no finance sign-off needed.
Booked the goods-in dock morning slot from 08:00 on Tuesday 10 November 2026 for the Hargrove Metals plate delivery, since that is the morning they said they would drop.

Confirmed the quote to Dana Vance at Vance Railings: 5800 for the balcony railing job, ready for collection in the week of Monday 16 November 2026. The price works off the 4 tonnes of plate coming in at 980 a tonne on the Hargrove order.
Greta Selby at Selby Alloys offers 6mm mild steel plate at 1010 per tonne, ex works, collection only, no delivery slots before December.
Booked two of our welders onto the WeldRight Training refresher day on Friday 20 November 2026 at 350 per person, 700 in total.
Ordered 30 MIG welding wire spools from Abel Tooling at 21 each, total 630, well under the finance sign-off line, for delivery to the workshop.
Toolbox talk minutes: reminded the crew to sweep the goods-in dock after each delivery and to log offcuts by thickness on the rack card.
To-do: pay the Selby Alloys invoice for the September aluminium order by Friday 20 November 2026.
Quick call with Dana Vance: their site survey of the balcony is done and the railing measurements stand as quoted; they are happy with the plan for the week of Monday 16 November 2026.
To-do: chase Casta Fasteners for the bolt delivery note before the stocktake on Friday 13 November 2026.

Luis Ferro at Hargrove Metals writes: owing to mill increases we have to put 6mm mild steel plate up to 1040 per tonne, and this applies to your 4 tonnes on the way to you. Your delivery on Tuesday 10 November 2026 is unchanged, same morning drop.

Monday production meeting: cutting list for the Vance Railings balcony job is finalised, first cuts start the morning after the plate lands, and the paint booth is reserved for the railings the following week.
Priya Nayak reminds the office that November supplier invoices should be coded to the November budget, and asks that any order paperwork reaches her by Thursday afternoons.
Note to self: staging area by the goods-in dock must be clear before the Hargrove lorry arrives; move the Abel Tooling pallets on Friday.
SafeGrip Supplies notice: our welding glove sizes run small this season; order a size up for the winter stock.
